notes.title: Blood Engine Patch Update v1.0.9.9c | ~1.64GB Download Size
notes.notes:
Several fixes, improvements and some minor additions.
I’m sorry about the large file size. I had to re-bake some data.
Save files are not affected.

Some known issues:
Achievement 35 is currently unattainable. And the w/s/up/down keys are not currently working with the menu system. I am working on this to be fixed in a future update.

If you have any problems with the game, or would like to report a bug. Please Email me at: bloodenginehelp@hotmail.com and I’ll try me best to solve your problems as soon as possible.
Thanks!
